integrity: The proof is self-contained except for the definition and elementary graph concepts. Finite verification is corroborative, not used as an infinite proof. The four-vertex path is a previously covered special case.
scientific_limitations: Classification is specific to double-star trees with both pendant sides nonempty, and the broadcast-dominating partition definition; literature and computational checks are not exhaustive beyond stated ranges.
title: Packing \(k\)-domatic chromatic spectrum of double-star trees
